MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 81
   C. 40.5
   D. 9

2. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

3. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 55
   C. 32
   D. 16

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 75
   B. 20
   C. 30
   D. 40

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

13. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

14. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

15. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

16. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
